V1 — Point value at r=0 without background (central p=0 term excluded) equals Eq. S27, sigma = L/(2 sqrt(2N)) / g; 1.802472 nm for L=50, N=100, fwhm=300 (hand derivation + analytic-gradient Fisher; fwhm->inf gives L/(2sqrt(2N))).

V2 — r->0 limit without background: sigma_lim^2 = L^2/(8N g^2)(3g^2+e^x)/(3g^2+2e^x), sqrt(tr/2) independent of approach direction; 1.605096 nm for L=50, N=100, fwhm=300 (derived from F_lim = alpha I + beta r r^T; numeric at |r|=1e-6 in 4 directions agrees).
V3 — rho = sigma_lim/sigma_pt = 2/sqrt5 exactly only in the quadratic case (sigma^2 = L^2/(10N)); at fwhm=300: 0.89439 (L=5), 0.89050 (L=50), 0.87805 (L=100), 0.85527 (L=150).

V4 — The limiting error ellipse is not round: sigma_par = (alpha+beta)^-1/2 along r-hat, sigma_perp = sigma_S27, alpha = 8Ng^2/L^2, beta = 16N e^x/(3L^2); L=100, N=100, quadratic: 2.7386 and 3.5355 nm.

V5 — The discontinuity comes from the central Fisher term tending to (beta/N) r r^T, which has no matrix limit (checked: 0.2174807 at |r|=1e-2..1e-6 vs beta/N=0.2174807 for L=50); equivalently sqrt(p3) ∝ |r| is not differentiable at 0.

V6 — With finite SBR (5, 10) point value = limit = Eq. S31 (agreement 1e-15); the limits SBR->inf and r->0 do not commute; at r_c = (sqrt3 L/4) e^{-x/2}/sqrt(SBR) the signal and background parts of p3 are equal and the central term is beta/2 (checked at SBR=1e4, 1e6).

V7 — Constant pedestal eps is exactly Eq. S31 at the centre with SBR_eps = 3e x e^{-x}/(4 eps) (because grad of sum I = 0 at r=0); combination rules 1/SBR_eff = 1/SBR + 1/SBR_eps (SBR against pure LG) and 1+1/SBR_eff = (1+1/SBR)(1+1/SBR_eps) (SBR against total beam signal) are exact (numerically 1e-15).

V8 — Gaussian pedestal: F_eps/F_S27 = 3x^2(e g - eps)^2/[g^2(e x+eps)(3(e x+eps)+eps e^x)] (hand derivation, numerically 1e-15, point = limit); not equivalent to a background (at the SBR reproducing the same centre p-vector the CRB differs, e.g. 3.8778 vs 3.8785 at L=50, eps=0.05).

V10 — With eps=0.002, L=100, fwhm=300, N=100 the CRB minimum is not at the centre: 3.877 nm at r=0 vs 3.628 nm at r=(5,0); transition scale sqrt(eps/(e a)) = 4.887 nm, L-independent by construction. Caveat: the CRB at r=5 depends on direction (3.628 along x, 3.694 along y, 3.583 at 45 deg), and the argmin position depends on L (3.5/6.7/9.0 nm along x for L=50/100/150), so 4.9 nm is a scale, not the minimum location.
V11 — Multiphoton exponent c: sigma_pt = L/(2c sqrt(2N)) / g; for c>=2 (in fact any c>1) limit = point value (central term ~ r^{2c-2}); L=100, N=100, quadratic: 3.536/1.768/1.179 nm for c=1/2/3.

V12 — Eq. S31 with N=500, SBR=5 at the centre gives 0.941/1.962/3.167 nm with fwhm=360 and 0.947/2.012/3.370 with fwhm=300 (published 0.94/1.96/3.16, taken from docs/literature note, PDF not opened); 1D L/(4sqrtN) = 1.25 nm for L=50, N=100.

V13 — Centre MLE with SBR=10 (L=50, N=100, fwhm=300) is efficient: own seed, 8000 reps: sigma = 1.9231 ± 0.0110, efficiency 0.981 ± 0.006, consistent with the claimed 1.9362 ± 0.0097 / 0.988 ± 0.005 (seed 42 reproduced exactly: 1.93614); CRB 1.96006 = Eq. S31. Note: the claimed SE sigma/sqrt(2R) is conservative by sqrt2.

V14 — Centre MLE without background is superefficient: sigma/sigma_lim = 0.840/0.822/0.828 (±0.005) for N=1e2/1e3/1e4 (own seeds), sigma/S27 = 0.748 at N=100; seed 42 reproduces sigma = 1.3456. Biased toward the centre: at r=(2,0), N=100 the bias in x is -0.338 ± 0.010 nm (24000 reps); the quoted -0.29 is a 2-sigma fluctuation of the 5000-rep seed-42 sample (reproduced exactly as -0.290 ± 0.022), so the better value to report is ≈ -0.34 nm.
V15 — MLE without background at r=(10,0), N=1000: efficiency 1.000 ± 0.007 (sigma 0.6264 vs CRB 0.6267), consistent with 0.999.

V16 — LMS without background at the centre: sigma_LMS = S27 exactly (analytic covariance L^2/(8N g^2)), so sigma/S27 = 1 and sigma/sigma_lim = 1/rho = 1.123; MC 0.997 ± 0.004 and 1.120; claimed 0.998/1.121 consistent.

V17 — Without the 1/s factor the LMS with SBR=10 shrinks the estimate by exactly s = 10/11 relative to the background-free LMS, at any r, not only linearly (the constant term (1-s)/4 * sum r_i vanishes); checked 0.90909 at (2,0), (0,3), (4,-2).

W1 — Vectorial RW donut, l=1 with sigma=+1 circular: on-axis intensity exactly 0 (independent direct 2D pupil quadrature gives I(0)/Imax ~1e-32 at z=0, 300, -500 nm; all components carry e^{i phi}, e^{2i phi}, e^{3i phi}).
W2 — Zero depth I(0)/Imax (Imax searched in 2D): opposite handedness 0.845241 (n=1.518) / 0.868963 (n=1.5); linear 0.371648 (n=1.518) / 0.382305 (n=1.5); x and y linear identical.

W3 — Peak-to-peak diameter 384.666 nm (n=1.518, F=5/3); with n=1.5: 515.52/401.35/382.87/377.62 nm for F=0.5/1/2/100 (independent 2D quadrature). Caveat: differs from Caprile2022 Fig.10 as transcribed (508/428/392/380), notably at F=1; do not claim agreement with Caprile at F=1.
W4 — Curvature at the zero c = 7.04223e-5 nm^-2 (n=1.518; exact via |dE/dx|^2/Imax, isotropic); curvature-matched LG fwhm = 327.141 nm; diameter-matched fwhm = 320.256 nm.

W5 — sigma=-1: on-axis Ex,Ey = 0 and Ez(0,z) = -(2pi/sqrt2) int g sin(theta) e^{ikz cos theta} dtheta != 0 (J0 kernel; matched 1e-15 at z=0,200,500 nm); sigma=+1: |Ez|^2 carries 21.76% of focal-plane energy (Parseval, exact; direct plane integral to 3 um 21.36%).

W6 — r->0 centre CRB, N=100, no background, n=1.518, L=50/100/150: vectorial correct 1.60041/3.32324/5.33104; LG fwhm=327.14 1.60124/3.32964/5.35145; LG fwhm=300 1.60510/3.36341/5.48647; opposite 147.886/89.588/84.197; linear (true 2D pattern, fixed x pol) 60.774/38.061/35.723; curvature-matched LG within 0.05/0.19/0.38% (direct Fisher with exact field gradient at |r|=1e-3 in 3 directions + general limit formula F/N=(f'L)^2/(2f^2) Id + 4c/(3f) rr).
W7 — Pixelated Gaussian PSF Fisher: sigma_PSF=100, pixel 100, 9x9, no bkg, N=400: CRB=5.2045 nm; pixel 10 nm, 121x121: CRB/(sigma/sqrtN)=1.000417.

W8 — With SBR_c=500 defined as total signal / background per pixel (SBR_total = 500/81 = 6.17), 9x9, N=600: CRB=4.964 nm and 591 photons for 5 nm. Caveat: if SBR=500 were total, CRB=4.268 nm and 437 photons; the convention must be stated.

W9 — MINFLUX S31 at the centre (point value), L=50, fwhm=300: 13.00/13.45/14.16/15.37/17.93 photons for 5 nm at SBR inf/50/20/10/5 (at SBR=inf this is the Eq. S27 point value; the r->0 limit would give 10.3).

W10 — Iterative MINFLUX (N_total=1000, 4x250, L=150->82.55->45.43->25, recentring, MLE in disk 0.75 L_k, 500 reps, own seeds): final sigma 0.506±0.012 / 0.521±0.012 nm without bkg, 0.606 / 0.607±0.014 with SBR=10, consistent with 0.497±0.011 / 0.613±0.014; without recentring 4.34/3.16/3.17/7.94 and 4.11/3.44/3.20/8.53 nm, consistent with 4.34/3.20/3.23/8.06; camera 3.162 nm.

W11 — sigma_iter vs N_total slope -0.526 and camera ratio 0.15–0.17 — qualitatively reproduced, not at the stated precision: with 3000–6000 reps I get sigma = 1.180±0.020 (N=250, ratio 0.187), 0.748, 0.509, 0.355, 0.2514±0.0024 (N=4000; worker 0.233), 0.1736 nm, slope -0.545 over the full range (-0.523 for N>=500), ratio 0.155–0.187. N=250 is heavy-tailed (none of 12 blocks of 500 reps reaches 1.094). Needs more reps under the same protocol, or restating as slope ≈ -0.52…-0.55 depending on range, ratio 0.155–0.19.

W12 — Gaussian pedestal eps, N=100, fwhm=300, centre CRB: L_opt = 10.484/23.280/50.337/80.810 nm, CRB = 0.7458/1.6787/3.8784/7.2867 nm for eps=0.002/0.01/0.05/0.15. Caveats: with eps=0 the CRB is monotonic increasing only for L < ring diameter fwhm/sqrt(ln2)=360 nm (diverges there, then decreases); L_opt/(fwhm sqrt eps) = 0.781/0.776/0.750/0.695 (fwhm-independent), so 0.78 holds only for eps <~ 0.01.

W13 — Misalignment (L=100, N=500, SBR=10, all 4 zeros displaced by delta in random directions, 20 patterns x 200 reps): naive MLE centre bias 1.45/3.81/7.76 nm (own draw) vs honest 0.16–0.20 (MC floor ≈0.17); naive sigma 1.84->2.02: the loss is bias. The claimed 1.58/4.01/8.31 are inside the ±10% pattern-sampling spread (population means from noise-free MLE 1.49±0.15 / 3.78±0.35 / 7.84±0.72 over 20-pattern draws, ≈0.75 delta).

history.summary: Núcleo del paquete + inferencia + derivación del CRB en el centro del TCP (valor puntual S27 vs límite r->0, forma cerrada exacta, pedestal eps, multifotón). Hallazgos: discontinuidad del CRB en r=0 sin fondo; MLE superficiente sin fondo (sesgado al centro, ≈-0.34 nm a r=2 nm); con cero casi perfecto el CRB mínimo no está en el centro.

Dona vectorial RW (cero exacto con handedness correcta; opuesta 0.845, lineal 0.372; LG igualada por curvatura reproduce el CRB vectorial a <0.4%), cámara (reproduce ~600 fotones de Balzarotti), iterativo (0.50 nm vs cámara 3.16 nm con 1000 fotones), L óptimo con cero imperfecto, desalineación (ingenuo sesgado ≈0.75 delta). Fixes R1 confirmados.
